scope: Windows diagnostic DLL load/run/explicit cleanup/unload; not a Modo plugin or native shading DLL unload test
limitations: This separately compiled diagnostic DLL includes the unchanged actual queue stress code; it is not the complete MoonRay shading DLL or Modo kit.
Explicit owners quiesce callers, stop/join workers and release CUDA resources before the loader calls FreeLibrary; no work or cleanup is attempted from DllMain.
The loader verifies identity while loaded and absence after release. This is controlled module-boundary evidence, not a guarantee for arbitrary concurrent plugin calls.
Sixteen successful GPU lifecycle cycles, sixteen missing-PTX fallback/cleanup cycles and two held-worker drains are covered across ten DLL load/unload cycles.
No native renderer or unit regressions were repeated because the queue implementation and existing verifier did not change. Previous multithread bitwise parity remains unresolved.
Device loss, integration with actual Modo shutdown and long-duration memory behavior remain unvalidated.
